selection_rule: First three numerically ordered subjects in the archived official DATASET_2 directory excluding already analyzed subject3: subject1, subject4, subject5. No replacement for missing downloads or failed quality checks. Subject1 GT was downloaded earlier, but no new model results used for selection.
input_duration: Entire available recording, as for subject3; report only the two fixed windows, unavailable/incomplete windows remain missing.
video_timing: Original container PTS -> nearest uniform30Hz frames -> existing BigSmall25Hz mapping
gt_timing: Original third-row timestamps, zero offset, no fitted lag, no extrapolation
quality_rules: finite three-row GT, strictly increasing timestamps, matching video/GT count
GT gap >250ms: mark recording failed original quality rule, do not relax
incomplete fixed window: mark unavailable; never replace subject/window
all missingness and failures remain in sample inventory
roi_rule: Fixed square selected from first source video frame before inference or GT spectral inspection; record coordinates and image. No output-based adjustment. Same crop for both models.

models.weights: Same existing checkpoints, no training or tuning

primary_metrics.filter: whole common sequence, detrend lambda100, order1 Butterworth filtfilt .75-2.5Hz
primary_metrics.rate: 30s nonoverlap, Hann, constant mean removal, nfft=N, no zero padding, max PSD in .75-2.5Hz
report: per-window prediction HR and contact-PPG-derived HR
MAE/RMSE/bias by subject and pooled available new windows
device HR mean and median auxiliary only

separate_sensitivity_analysis.input: raw PPG linearly interpolated to common30Hz, same samples for Hann and boxcar, no bandpass, mean removed, no zero padding
separate_sensitivity_analysis.competing_peak_rule: Top two interior local PSD maxima in band, >=6bpm apart and second/first power >=0.5, in Hann raw reference; report continuous ratio regardless of flag. Also flag if Hann/boxcar global peak differs by >=4bpm. Exploratory thresholds fixed here for new subjects; not validated quality criteria and never exclusion criteria.
report: all candidate peaks and power ratios
Hann and boxcar rates side by side
flag frequency with available and missing denominators
separate_sensitivity_analysis.selection: Never choose method closest to device HR or substitute sensitivity into primary metrics

prohibitions: no parameter optimization against device HR
do not overwrite subject3 original or diagnostic outputs
claim_limit: Small descriptive replication, no population or model superiority claim
